mechanism: Indomethacin may reduce renal clearance of meprobamate and increase CNS depression when combined, while meprobamate may potentiate indomethacin's gastrointestinal and renal effects.
action: Monitor for increased meprobamate toxicity (dizziness, ataxia, confusion) and enhanced CNS depression; consider alternative anxiolytic or reduce meprobamate dose; avoid combination if possible.
